2014_spells.expeditious-retreat.descript: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.
2014_spells.expeditious-retreat.effectSu: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.expeditious-retreat.fullDesc: Using 1 bonus action, when you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action. This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
